final: WITH p AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS mean_avg FROM p WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_rate, p.avg_rate - m.mean_avg AS excess FROM p, m WHERE p.avg_rate > m.mean_avg), r AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) AS rnk FROM k) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate, excess, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk
